scope: Prospective continuation of both predeclared daily development branches: C_1epoch from B_epoch1, C_3epochs from B_epoch3; final endpoint only.
authorization: 2026-09-18 latest user asks small daily-update tests before expanding training/motivation. Four GPUs and complete-epoch parameter iteration already authorized.
experiment: Do not retrain A. B traverses all D19 known-positive requests for 3 complete epochs, evaluates the predeclared epoch1 and epoch3 endpoints on all D20 positives. From B_epoch1, C_1epoch fits D20 for 1 epoch; from B_epoch3, C_3epochs fits D20 for 3 epochs. Each C compares its own exact parent on all D21 positive requests; C_3epochs evaluates only epoch3. Both branches continue real AdamW. This is one seed and two settings, not independent replications.
evaluation_rule: Same1M initial catalog, FP32 free beam300, primary NDCG@50, all OOV misses retained, full next-day positive requests. Keep NDCG/Recall20/50/100, user means, matched random mean and5000-trial null99, and Top50hit requests/users. Sampled768-per-day with1000 distractors remain separate diagnostics. Report every setting and both edges, absolute delta and ratio; no upper bound or preferred percentage for improvement.
working_gate: Each parent/current should exceed2x exact matched random expectation and its null99; current>parent on each of two next-day panels is a descriptive stability screen. Rare-hit counts and single-seed limits remain visible. No release automatically admitted; no reuse comparisons until separate Full admission.
interpretation: This tests daily-update feasibility, not a causal same-window comparison against the completed3-day branch, whose training and future dates differ. Larger relative gain can arise from tiny base NDCG, changing item coverage and content freshness. It is not an AUC multiple. Training epochs are predeclared, never chosen from favorable future labels.

resource_estimate.training: Four-rank DDP, global128, measured337.03requests/s; B3~62s, C1~17s, C3~52s pure training plus initialization/NLL/checkpoint I/O.
resource_estimate.evaluation: Seven full one-day evaluations across B and C branches: D20 10171requests and D21 8866requests, four independent GPU workers. Based on previous6L full evaluation, allow4-6min per model/day plus sampled scoring and startup.
resource_estimate.execution: One detached tmux pipeline, serial four-GPU phases, all logs/exit states retained. Evaluation workers coexist only with waiting training ranks using CPU Gloo.

canary: Daily B from the actual trained A, complete263-request/3step subset including7-row tail on four GPUs; verify actualAdamW continuation, day19fit/day20eval, finite loss, serial8/4 evaluation. Previous6L four-rank numerical and resident-evaluation canaries remain applicable. Canary cannot initialize a noncanary run.
